E0337

`#Patchable` struct has a function-typed field (D-PATCH1)

What

`#Patchable` struct has a function-typed field (D-PATCH1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0337

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0337: tests/ui/patchable_fn_field.stderr.

Error [E0337]: `#[Patchable]` struct `Worker` field `step` has function type
  --> tests/ui/patchable_fn_field.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     step: fn(Int) Int
    |     ^^^^
 Why: patches are data values — function-typed fields can't be patched
 Fix: store a callable handle type instead, or drop `#[Patchable]`
